mapper.select:
select A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_ABBR as prodAbbr, A.FINPROD_NAME as prodName, B.SALE_DEPARTMENT as saleDepartment, A.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, C.PAY_CYCLE as payIntRule, A.CCY as ccy, A.VDATE as prodVdate, A.MDATE as prodMdate, B.LAY_TYPE as layType, B.PROD_REGIST_CODE as prodRegistCode from FIN_PRODUCT A left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO D on A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE C on D.CASH_ID = C.CASH_ID
where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
and not exists ( select 1 from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE temp where D.CASH_ID = temp.CASH_ID
and temp.EFF_DATE > C.EFF_DATE )

select PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE as prodType, B.BRANCH as sonFinprodId, C.CUSTOM_LEVEL as customLevel, C.AMT_MIN as amtMin, C.AMT_MAX as amtMax, C.TERM_MAX as termMax, C.TERM_MIN as termMin, E.AMOUNT as intAccrPrinAmt, D.YIELD as theoryYield, C.FINPROD_ID as layFinprodId, B.VDATE as sonProdVdate, B.MDATE as sonProdMdate, D.BASIS as basis from FIN_PRODUCT A left join PRD_LAYER_PARAM on A.FINPROD_ID=PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID left join PRD_LAYER_PARAM C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO F on A.FINPROD_ID =f.FINPROD_ID AND F.CASH_TYPE_1='01' left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE D on B.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND D.CASH_ID = F.CASH_ID left join PTL_SEC_POSITION E on E.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID and E.BRANCH = B.BRANCH where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

select a.BRANCH as sonFinprodId, b.AMOUNT as intAccrPrinAmt, a.VDATE as sonProdVdate, a.MDATE as sonProdMdate, a.BASIS as basis, c.DEAL_MODE prodType, D.BASIS as basis, D.YIELD as theoryYield from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT a left join PTL_SEC_POSITION b on a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.BRANCH = B.BRANCH
left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c on a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID left join (select a1.finprod_id, a1.BASIS, a1.branch, a1.YIELD, row_number() over(partition by a1.finprod_id, a1.branch order by EFF_DATE desc) ro from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE A1 left join FIN_CASH_INFO B1 on A1.CASH_ID = B1.CASH_ID where B1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and B1.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_LX} and B1.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_LX}) d on a.BRANCH = d.branch and a.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and d.ro = 1 where a.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and b.AMOUNT > 0

select b.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bussId, A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, B.TRADE_DATE PayDate, b.vdate PayintStartDate, b.mdate PayintEndDate, b.mdate - b.vdate thisIntAccrDay, b.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, b.INT_AMT actCusProfit, C.Interest theoryCusProfit, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, A.CCY CCY, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, d.IS_LAY isLay, e.PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode from FIN_PRODUCT A left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID and B.PS = #{PS_ZJSX,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and b.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and b.BUSI_TYPE = #{BUSI_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL c on b.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = c.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join fin_product_add d on a.FINPROD_ID = d.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD e on A.FINPROD_ID = e.FINPROD_ID where B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_LCCP,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.Finprod_Id sonFinprodId, T2.Prod_Style prodType, T4.Remain_Prin_Amt intAccrPrinAmt, T4.THEORY_INT theoryInt, T3.Int_Amt actInt FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.Finprod_Id LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN pa_trd_product_deal T4 ON T4.Trade_Id = T3.Trade_Id WHERE T1.p_Finprod_Id = #{finprodId} and T3.Totle_Trade_Id=#{tradeId}
